title: Module review
subtitle: Everything from Australia, New Zealand and South Africa
objectives: Explain climate and labelling in each

steps.prompt: Match each region to its signature grape.
steps.explanation: Each region has made one grape its signature.

steps.prompt: Why does South Australia have very old ungrafted vines?
options: Phylloxera never arrived thanks to quarantine
steps.explanation: Strict quarantine has kept phylloxera out.

steps.prompt: Which cool influences shape South Africa's Cape?
steps.explanation: The Cape has a Mediterranean climate with dry summers, not monsoons.

steps.prompt: Central Otago has a maritime climate.
steps.explanation: Not true. It's New Zealand's only continental region.

steps.prompt: Pinotage was created by crossing Pinot Noir with ____.
steps.explanation: Cinsault, then called Hermitage in South Africa.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Australia ranges from hot Barossa to cool Tasmania
New Zealand is maritime, except continental Central Otago
South Africa is cooled by ocean winds, with Chenin and Pinotage as signatures
Old vines matter in all three countries
